author: Muhammad Zulhusni
description:
A supply-chain attack has affected more than 400 npm packages maintained by unrelated publishers, using compromised package releases to steal developer credentials and spread to other projects. Microsoft Threat Intelligence said the malicious releases contain a variant of the Mini Shai-Hulud worm.
